body:
## Verified resolution

Fixed in local ES commit `6b473c26e8cc03cbd509b3056c60aaf84cb8dbc0`, included in clean qualified final source `4e410dc9a816cc947f16235ad2b24824b29dd84e`. [Published source-overlay evidence](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/d5e2f78618624cad919afaba6784bef3f7eaf8c7/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-07-cloud-validator/ui/README.md) provides rejected/original and corrected frames, exact source/build/catalog hashes, passing checks, independent review and canonical CF01–CF15 references. #508 now explicitly tracks this exact source for integration and pin promotion; its body was read back before this closure. This closes the verified draft-source defect, not the parent integration/firmware/public-adoption gate. Accepted firmware and the installed handheld remain unchanged.

## Observed defect

The required #510 visual coverage found two clipped French strings on the actual 640×480 guest at ES1d5397fda9d7c5c2a4c7f9390ef49b9bb4b879ce: the saves instructions heading truncates its screenshot category, and the content-folder text-entry title truncates game content. Source/binary/catalog identities and rejected frames are retained by rc_cloud_ui in walk-fr640-help-paths. Settings and game-content help fit.

Already written: this source is a local unintegrated draft. Accepted firmware, product pins and personal clouds are unchanged. Correcting these labels does not move or reorganize files.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes. Existing synthetic selected paths and controller navigation on GENERIC_X64 show the affected copy at the actual small panel size; no physical action or real provider is needed.

## Fix boundary

Preserve complete category meaning. The independent-folder row keeps its full label; the content text-entry modal can omit redundant FOLDER. Saves instructions use a short heading and put game saves, save states and screenshots in the wrapping body. Reuse existing prose/editor components. Batch any other confirmed fit defects from the already planned inventory before one further source/catalog rebuild; do not add a full unrelated application sweep.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Rejected original frames and exact tested identities remain in the #510 packet.
- [x] English/French source and catalog checks pass on the committed correction, with no loss of category meaning or folder-selection behavior.
- [x] Actual corrected small-panel frames show both full category scope and readable editor title without ellipsis; affected large-panel coverage or explicit unchanged-input justification is indexed.
- [x] Canonical flow/reference and exact-source screenshot index are updated together before completion/pin promotion, under D-WORKFLOW-156.
- [x] Qualified final source is included in #508 integration tracking; existing unaffected #512 diagnostic proof keeps precise provenance.

Source/proof ownership completed and released; remaining product integration is tracked in #508. This is part of #508 qualification before #507, not a new release phase.
title: M7.P5: Fit cloud guidance and path editing on small screens
